name: flowart
description: Zakereh Art: art portfolio and workshop booking site

scripts.dev: concurrently -n worker,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:pretend: concurrently -n worker,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:e2e -w apps/worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/worker && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
